snippet.title: Battle Orb Trailer - Mixed Reality PvP on Meta Quest
snippet.description:
Battle Orb is a fast-paced mixed reality PvP strategy game! Aim, launch, and clash in real-time battles with 2–4 players using pool-style physics and powerful abilities. Build your squad, conquer unique arenas, and climb the leaderboard—all in your own space!

Follow us on our socials here: https://linktr.ee/mixrift

Join the discussion on Discord: https://mixrift.com/discord
